tiktok.auth: user access token with the video.publish scope (Authorization: Bearer, to open.tiktokapis.com only)
tiktok.chunk_bytes: 64 000 000 (the guide: 5-64 MB, the final chunk up to 128 MB); a file of at most that size whole
tiktok.retries: 5xx, 429, connection errors and timeouts on a chunk: exponential backoff (or Retry-After), then the same chunk again; 416: the post's uploaded_bytes and a resume; the init POST is retried only on 429/5xx answers

vimeo.auth: personal access token (Authorization: bearer, to api.vimeo.com only)
vimeo.retries: 5xx, 429, connection errors and timeouts on PATCH/HEAD: exponential backoff (or Retry-After), then HEAD and a resume from Upload-Offset; the create POST is retried only on 429/5xx answers

x.auth: OAuth 2.0 user access token with media.write, tweet.write, tweet.read and users.read (Authorization: Bearer, to api.x.com only)
x.chunk_bytes: 4 MiB (the guide: at or below 5 MB)
x.retries: 5xx, 429, connection errors and timeouts on an append: exponential backoff (or Retry-After / x-rate-limit-reset), then the same segment_index again, and finalize's size must equal the file's; initialize and finalize are retried only on 429/5xx answers; the post only on 429 (never twice)

youtube.retries: 5xx, 429, rate-limit reasons, connection errors and timeouts: exponential backoff (or Retry-After), then the session's status and a resume

tools.description: Check a deliverable and its title / description / tags / privacy / thumbnail / captions against the platform's upload limits, and the deliverable against ffmpeg-skill's delivery spec (`check`), offline (structured FAIL with a fix per row, nothing uploaded; exit 1 unless the verdict is PASS or WARN)

Upload a deliverable, its thumbnail and captions to a platform (YouTube: the Data API v3 resumable upload; Vimeo: the tus resumable upload, title, description and privacy only; TikTok: the Content Posting API Direct Post, title and privacy only; X: the chunked media upload and one public post, its text the title). Dry run unless --confirm carries the token the dry run printed for exactly this file, metadata and platform; then a receipt, redacted
Python, ffmpeg-skill, and per platform: uploader implemented, credentials present / absent (never values)
Credentials in the OS keychain: status (present / absent, never values), login (values from stdin or a hidden prompt, never from argv), logout
